versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Enterprise Risk Management Engine.

- Provides a comprehensive ERM framework based on ISO 31000 and COSO ERM.
- Structured risk context and appetite templates for organizational setup.
- Detailed risk universe covering 8 main categories and key sub-risks.
- Risk register YAML template to standardize documentation and assessment.
- Guidance on risk identification methods and risk assessment matrices.
- Includes best practices for risk monitoring and appetite statement governance.
